run_joint_friction_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation that loads a door URDF and applies joint friction and torque controls
create_debug_parameter_sliders: create interactive debug parameter sliders for joint friction and torque using addUserDebugParameter
set_joint_motor_control: set joint motor control using VELOCITY_CONTROL or TORQUE_CONTROL modes via setJointMotorControl2
change_link_dynamics: change linear and angular damping for a body and all its joints using changeDynamics
inspect_joint_info: inspect joint information and enumerate all joints using getNumJoints and getJointInfo
